_doc: Every scheduled job this plugin queues, what it touches, whether it moves money, and the method(s) that do the work.
A scheduled run has no user it chose: no nonce, no capability, and on the Action Scheduler async runner
possibly the cookie of whichever admin loaded the page that kicked the queue. So a job decides with no
identity, or actor_reason says why the identity it reads is safe.
ScheduledWorkAuthorityTest finds jobs in the Action Scheduler store and WP-Cron (not in this file), and
fails when one is undeclared, when runs names a method that is gone, when nothing listens, when a
listener or runs method reads the current user without actor_reason, and when a retired hook is still queued.

wpss_audit_log_cleanup.touches: Deletes audit rows older than the retention setting.

wpss_auto_complete_orders.touches: Completes delivered orders the buyer did not answer within the review window, which credits the vendor's earnings.

wpss_check_late_orders.touches: Marks in-progress orders past their delivery deadline as late; notifies both sides.

wpss_check_requirements_timeout.touches: Starts or cancels paid orders whose requirements never arrived; a cancel refunds the buyer.

wpss_cleanup_abandoned_extensions.touches: Closes unpaid extension sub-orders left past the abandon window. Nothing was paid.

wpss_cleanup_abandoned_milestones.touches: Closes unpaid milestone phases left past the abandon window. Nothing was paid.

wpss_cleanup_abandoned_tips.touches: Closes unpaid tip sub-orders left past the abandon window. Nothing was paid.

wpss_cleanup_expired_requests.touches: Expires buyer requests past their end date.

wpss_cron_daily.touches: Dispute deadlines: reminders, escalation, and opening disputes on long-late orders.

wpss_email_retry.touches: Resends one of this plugin's emails that failed, from a stashed payload.

wpss_gateway_refund_received.touches: Records a refund the payment rail reported, re-queued while this site is sending a refund on the same order.

wpss_notification_cleanup.touches: Deletes read notifications older than 90 days.

wpss_process_auto_withdrawals.touches: Creates automatic withdrawal requests for eligible vendors through the one locked writer.
wpss_process_auto_withdrawals.conditional_on: Queued only while automatic withdrawals are enabled under Payouts.

wpss_process_cancellation_timeouts.touches: Applies cancellation requests the vendor did not answer in time, which refunds the buyer.

wpss_process_offline_auto_cancel.touches: Cancels offline-payment orders never paid within the hold window. No money was taken.

wpss_recalculate_seller_levels.touches: Recomputes each vendor's seller level from their stats.

wpss_send_deadline_reminders.touches: Emails vendors about orders nearing their deadline.

wpss_send_delayed_message_email.touches: Sends a held new-message email if the recipient has not read the message meanwhile.

wpss_send_requirements_reminders.touches: Emails buyers who have not sent order requirements.

wpss_utc_migrate_batch.touches: Converts one batch of stored local times to UTC during the one-time migration.

retired.wpss_cleanup_review_votes: Review-vote cleanup was removed; Plugin::maybe_run_install() unschedules it on upgrade. Completed rows may remain in the store.
